content.text:
I read the transcript, mapped every record item to at most one key item, and checked each figure, owner and date against the final version stated in the meeting. Summary of what I found:

**Coverage gaps:** The record collapses all four life events into a single relocation entry, so only one key life event can be credited (e1 job change, e3 home sale, e4 Graham's remote approval go uncredited as standalone items). The pre-existing trading hold on the joint account (a4) is missing entirely, and there is no action item assigning Renata the "pause the auto-investment tonight in the Ferrant app" task (i7) — the record only carries it as an account action.

**Errors:** Item 11's due date of 2026-09-22 is wrong; "end of next week" from a Tuesday 9/15 meeting is Friday, 2026-09-25.

**Good:** All corrected figures were caught — the vested $387,240 (not $430,000), the October 30 closing (not October 13), $340,000 into the ladder, $353,800 net proceeds, $24,500 deferral limit. No NOT-ACTION item (cabin, Roth conversion, 529 move, backdoor Roth, de-risking, COBRA) leaked into the record.

**Duplicates:** Items 4 and 5 split the house-account action into ladder and money-market legs; item 7 restates item 9 from the signer's side.

key_items.note: No standalone life event for the Grevholm-to-Venholt job change. Record item 1 contains the offer details (Venholt, 10/05, $265k, $40k sign-on, $15k lump sum) but is already paired to e2 as the relocation event; it also omits the 9/25 last day and the $42,760 forfeited unvested profit-sharing.

Headline event is the Franklin relocation effective 10/01. Lease figures all match: 12 months, $4,150/month, start 2026-10-01, movers pack 9/28. Children starting Franklin schools 10/05 is not stated, but no figure is wrong. Life event: owner/date not applicable.

Home sale is only a nested sub-block inside record item 1 (already paired to e2), not its own life event. The nested figures are right ($392k basis, $48k kitchen, $604k sale, 10/30 close, $353,800 net), but the ~$128,000 gain, the $500,000 married-couple exclusion and the mail-away close are absent.

Graham's fully-remote approval from Tollefsrud Mutual appears only as a sub-field of record item 1 (paired to e2), not as a separate life event. The two-or-three-days-a-quarter Minneapolis travel is compressed to 'quarterly in-person sessions'.
Direct rollover of the vested Grevholm balance to Ferrant captured. Uses the corrected $387,240 vested figure, not the initially quoted ~$430,000 total. Account action: no owner/date required.

Opening the separate joint house account at Ferrant for the sale proceeds; $353,800 matches the estimated settlement statement. The $340,000 ladder and $13,800 money-market remainder are split off into record items 4 and 5, graded as duplicates.

Pause of the joint-account automatic contribution for Oct/Nov/Dec 2026 with January 2027 restart is exact. Amount is listed as NOT_FOUND rather than $2,000, so it carries no incorrect figure; the $2,000 was stated in the meeting and should have been captured.
The standing hold Hollis placed on the joint account before the meeting - no sales realizing gains until after October 1, 2026 - is not recorded anywhere.

Owner Jules Marchetti and due 2026-10-06 both match the revised date (moved from Friday 9/18 because the recordkeeper needs the termination posted). Beneficiary designations (Graham primary, Theo and Ingrid 50/50 contingent) are not captured, but no figure is wrong.

Owner correctly reassigned to Jules Marchetti after Hollis said he is out 9/21-9/25. Due date is wrong: recorded as 2026-09-22, but 'end of next week' from a Tuesday 9/15 meeting is Friday, 2026-09-25. Packet contents and the copy-Hollis-and-clients instruction are also compressed to 'residency and tax questions'.
Owner Graham Brennock correct. Due 2026-09-30 is a faithful rendering of 'before October 1' so the October check comes out right; task text repeats the before-10/01 constraint.

Owner Renata, due 2026-10-05 (first day, benefits enrollment) both correct, and the $24,500 combined 2026 limit is right. Overriding the 6% auto-enrollment and asking about the match true-up are not captured, but nothing recorded is wrong.
Both spouses named as owners; licenses, Williamson County voter registration and vehicle registration all present; due 2026-10-31 matches the 30-day window from October 1 residency.
Owner Jules Marchetti, due 2026-10-23 - the Friday a week ahead of the corrected October 30 closing, exactly as Jules restated it.

No action item for Renata to make the pause in the Ferrant app tonight (9/15) before the October 1 draft. Record item 2 captures the pause as an account action and is already paired to a3, so the owner and the tonight deadline are lost.

extra_items.note: Splits the house-account action (a2, paired to record item 3) into its investment leg. Figures are accurate - $340,000 across 3/6/9/12-month T-bills - but it restates part of an action already recorded.
Splits off the remainder leg of the same house-account action. The $13,800 money-market figure matches Hollis's 'about thirteen eight', so it is accurate but not a distinct action.

Restates record item 9 from the signer's side: Renata signing the same Grevholm distribution form and Ferrant IRA application Jules is preparing, on the same 2026-10-06 date. The meeting assigned one task, to Jules.
